The Apple HomeView pre-order discount is back and the deal AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off is still flying, but we are also tracking return all-time lows on Apple Watch Ultra 4 at nearly $100 off and today we spotted a series of major clearance deals on Apple Watch Ultra 3 at $250 off. We also have a rare discount on the most affordable Silver MacBook Neo (and up to $120 off models from the Apple refurb store), all-time lows on Apple’s new iPhone/AirPods Wrist Strap, the latest 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C Braided Cable in all four colors at just $18, and much more waiting below.

Update: The 2026 Apple Polishing Cloth is now back in-stock at $9 Prime shipped.

Amazon’s AirPods Pro 3 deal is back at over 20% off

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)

Amazon’s pre-order discount on the new Apple HomeView is back

Amazon’s pre-order discount on the new Apple HomeView has returned once again today. While shipping at times at Apple have gotten better on some models, Amazon is now selling it for less and delivering quicker to some regions of the country.

Over at Amazon you’ll now find the new Apple HomeView starting down at $289.99 shipped. You likely know the drill already here with these early pre-order deals on Apple gear at Amazon – the price drop isn’t huge, but it is still less than Apple and just about everywhere else so you might as well keep some coffee money in your pocket.

Delivery times at Amazon will vary depending on your location, but that seems to be the case with Apple this release season as well – it will provide an estimation and then it will change after the order is placed based on availability and the other usual factors in some cases.

As of right now, Amazon is only offering the Space Gray variant at discounted rate and this deal has been coming and going for the better part of a week now after the initial blast. You might want to get in there while you can.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 now $250 off for today only: Some of the best prices ever

Amazon is now offering the latest Apple Watch Ultra 4 back down at all-time low prices with nearly $100 in savings, but for those who just don’t need the newest model, we are tracking massive $250 price drops on Apple Watch Ultra 3 today. The gorgeous Milanese Loop models have now hit some of the lowest prices ever at Amazon in both the Natural and Black Titanium case coloways at Amazon, as well as the more affordable Black Ocean Band model down at $549, and there are additional configs live at Best Buy today as well.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 Black Ocean $549 (Orig. $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 Black Milanese $649 (Orig. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 Natural Milanese $649 (Orig. $899)

Best Buy is delivering a particularly notable $250 off a collection of Apple Watch Ultra 3 models for today only as well. Amazon might very well price match here on these Ultra 3 configs at any time now as well, but these are easily among the best prices we have ever tracked either way.

For today only, as part of its Deals of the Day, Best Buy is offering some banger deals on Apple Watch Ultra 3. All of the originally $799 models in the sale have now dropped to $549, or $250 off, to deliver some of the lowest prices we have ever tracked here:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 Black Trail $549 (Orig. $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 Black Alpine $549 (Orig. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 Blue Ocean $549 (Orig. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 Blue Alpine $549 (Orig. $799)

New Apple Watch Ultra 4 just dropped back to all-time low at nearly $100 off [Updated]

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Burgundy Trail $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Burgundy Alpine $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Desert Alpine $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Sand Trail $699 (Reg. $799)

Rare deal hits Apple’s most affordable Silver MacBook Neo today (Best price in months)

Deals on Apple’s MacBook Neo have ben very hard to come by, and it might be the only model in the lineup that actually has a chance to stay close to full price for Black Friday. That said, we are tracking a rare price on the most affordable Silver model today – it is now at the best price in months on Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the 256GB MacBook Neo in the Silver colorway down at $669.22 shipped. This is the same price we featured on the Citrus model yesterday and you can still score this deal on the Blush pink variant.

Clearly not a giant deal, but since the price increase back in late June (and even before that), MacBook Neo hasn’t really seen sizable price drops. If you are looking to score Apple’s most affordable MacBook, it is now sitting at the lowest price in nearly 5 months.

That said, and much like we detailed last go around, the official Apple Refurbished Store does have some Neo configs in stock right now for even less with a proper Apple warranty in tow – the most affordable 256GB config is now out of stock, but there are a couple 512GB models at $120 under the new list price:

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB w/ Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799 new)

These machines ship with:

  • Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare eligibility
  • Apple’s Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale

Alongside the reveal and subsequent launch of the latest iPhone 18 Pro/Max and iPhone Duo, Apple updated its accessory lineup with a range of cases and the new Wrist Strap – the latter has now dropped to a new Amazon all-time low from under $22 Prime shipped. You’ll also find a series of deals on the Apple Crossbody Strap below as well.

While not all of the new Apple Wrist Straps are seeing solid discounts you will find a couple colors at up to 25% off – this is the lowest price we have tracked to date:

  • Apple Wrist Strap – Taupe $22 (Reg. $29)
  • Apple Wrist Strap – Olive $22.50 (Reg. $29)

Apple’s 13 and 15-inch M5 MacBook Air drop back to best prices in months at $200 off

While we were already tracking the $200 price drops on various 13-inch models, those deals are continuing today and are joined by the same Prime Day discounts on some 15-inch models as well.
